summary:
Novochar (নভোচার, "spacefarer") is a full-stack, browser-based astronomy platform built around NASA's SPHEREx mission, originally developed as an entry for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge — "Planet X and SPHEREx." 
Modern surveys overwhelm human inspection. SPHEREx maps the entire sky every six months in 102 near-infrared bands and returns images of more than a billion objects. Yet asteroids, comets, brown dwarfs, high proper-motion stars, and hypothetical distant planets reveal themselves through position changes between epochs — a signal that is invisible unless observations are aligned, stretched consistently, and compared side by side. 
Around that core, Novochar has grown into a broad exploration platform with six views:

- MISSION — survey dashboard and mission telemetry.

- SKY VIEW — a 3D celestial-sphere explorer, a free-flight procedural world, and a Sun-centred spherical-shell observer that classifies objects as located, uncertain, or unknown by distance evidence.

- SPHEREx VIEW — real SPHEREx field comparison plus a WebGL2 3D sky explorer.

- BLINK VIEW — the blink comparator and a spectral-analysis workbench with line identification, continuum fitting, AUTO-z estimation, and export.

- SEARCH — a filterable candidate catalogue and a live IVOA archive workbench.

- DATA SOURCES — provenance cards, archive registry, and an optional live NASA NEO feed.
details:
Novochar is a public-facing astronomical sky viewer and blink comparator for NASA's SPHEREx mission, built as a React + Express web application. It displays real SPHEREx near-infrared observations of the North Ecliptic Pole across two epochs, reprojected onto a shared grid with verified SHA-256 provenance, and lets users compare them side by side, one at a time, or as an animated blink. Supporting views provide a 3D sky explorer, a Sun-centred spherical-shell distance observer, a searchable candidate catalogue, a spectral-analysis workbench, and live IVOA archive queries.

Item Detail

Purpose Make multi-epoch sky change visible, comparable, and scientifically honest for public, student, and research audiences.

Stack React 18 + Vite 7, Node.js + Express, Three.js/WebGL2, npm workspaces.

Science core Pure JS coordinate transforms, HEALPix, cross-matching, frames, epochs, and shell geometry; pinned Python sidecar for FITS reprojection only.

Data modes Real SPHEREx QR2 archive products, deterministic seeded simulation, and clearly labelled illustrative prototypes.

Deployment Local Express origin or Vercel serverless + CDN, with precomputed static data and a verified offline SPHEREx bundle.

Status Working full-stack application with real regional SPHEREx data; global 3D layer illustrative; quantitative difference deliberately gated off.
